title: Your Pixel 11 won’t miss a chance to tell when it’s using the new Extreme Charging Mode
summary: The Pixel Weather screensaver will be one of those places where it shows.
body: Credit: Rita El Khoury / Android Authority TL;DR Pixel Weather is getting subtle upgrades, including a new icon, right after the Pixel 11 launch. The AI weather summary is now called Weather Brief, while the app tells you the last time it updated the weather. Pixel Weather Screensaver is also getting ready to inform you when your device uses the new Extreme Charging Mode. Just after officially launching the new Pixel devices yesterday , Google is pushing out a set of new icons to its system apps. One of those is the Pixel Weather app, which is not only getting a slightly updated icon, but also a few new features that we’ve discovered and will discuss below. You’re reading an Authority Insights story. title: The Neighbourhood’s ‘Sweater Weather’ Cozies Its Way Into YouTube’s Billion Views Club
summary: The Jesse Rutherford-fronted band released “Sweater Weather” as the lead single from their 2013 debut studio album, I Love You.
body: Just in time for fall, The Neighbourhood have hit a big milestone: The California rock band has joined YouTube’s Billion Views Club with their 2012 alternative hit “Sweater Weather.” The Jesse Rutherford-fronted band released “Sweater Weather” as the lead single from their 2013 debut studio album, I Love You . The album peaked at No. 25 on the Billboard 200 , while the track reached No. 14 on the Billboard Hot 100 . A previous indie music video was released alongside the song when it dropped, but that version was unlisted after they signed with Columbia Records. The official music video was uploaded to YouTube in March 2013, during the era of Tumblr aesthetics, at a moment when “indie sleaze” and soft-grunge subcultures were found on the platform.
